_doc: Tester missions, generated by docs/testing/tester_missions.py from the demo manifests, known-demos.json and its list of functions. A mission names a goal, never the steps: testers use the user documentation and the RasQberry helper. group: one of groups; needs: what a tester must have, as keys of needs_keys, so the tester helper can match missions to a tester's setup; maturity beta: early beta, not yet tested by people; part: one part of a demo (a variant of its manifest); status coming: not in the images yet.

missions.title: First start
missions.goal: Install RasQberry with Raspberry Pi Imager, with your own user name, password and Wi-Fi, and reach the desktop.
